issues.message: User controlled data in methods like `innerHTML`, `outerHTML` or `document.write` is an anti-pattern that can lead to XSS vulnerabilities
issues.resolution: Fixed: replaced the `innerHTML` sink with DOM construction (createElement/textContent/createTextNode). `VML.tooltip.show` now accepts a DOM node, `renderStats` and `renderLegend` build their content with DOM APIs, and the chart tooltips (`heatTip`/`barTip`/`tip` in charts.js) return DOM nodes. No data is parsed as HTML anymore.

issues.message: subprocess call - check for execution of untrusted input. (B603)
issues.resolution: Fixed in scripts/netlat.sh embedded worker and in every committed copy under scripts/runs/run-*: ping binary is resolved via shutil.which() (full path, fixes B607), each dst is validated with ipaddress.ip_address() before use, subprocess args are passed as a list with no shell, and the static rules that cannot be satisfied by code alone are suppressed with targeted `# nosec` comments. Also fixed a latent StatisticsError when NETLAT_PACKETS=1 (jitter of a single sample now returns 0.0).
